description: Runs a Monte Carlo retirement simulation against the real pot, and reports how often it lasts. Use for 'will my pension last', 'can I retire at 60', 'what if I put more in'. Nothing is saved - this is a calculation, not a change.

annualContribution.description: Yearly saving until retirement. Defaults to the saving Foliopeak holds outside pensions - usually none.

annualWithdrawal.description: Yearly spend in retirement, today's money. Defaults to 25000.

name: get_retirement_projection
title: Retirement projection
